supporting_observations.claim: At 14:18:47 UTC, WS-GLUND-01 logged event 4648 for PowerShell running as SYSTEM and targeting svc-docsync on DC-MAP-01. This is within the review window, but later than the alert's reported activity around 13:40.
The recorded host is WS-GLUND-01, whereas the supplied inventory says the svc-docsync job runs on FILE-MAP-01. This difference warrants investigation but does not establish malicious activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: Only one log record was supplied; it does not show the repeated failures described by the alert.
The 4648 record does not establish whether authentication succeeded or failed.
The record identifies SYSTEM as the subject but does not identify the person or process activity that initiated the PowerShell execution.
claims_not_established: Whether svc-docsync had repeated failed domain logons around 13:40 UTC.
Whether the 14:18 event was related to the scheduled password rotation or a manual job update.
Whether the credential use was authorized, and whether it resulted in a successful logon.
Why PowerShell running as SYSTEM on WS-GLUND-01 used svc-docsync credentials.
additional_evidence_needed: Domain-controller authentication records for svc-docsync from 13:20 to 14:20 UTC, including success and failure events.
PowerShell, process-creation, and logon-session telemetry from WS-GLUND-01 around 14:18 UTC, including process ancestry and the initiating user or task.
Password-rotation and DocSync update records showing who performed the change and whether the job was updated.
Relevant FILE-MAP-01 DocSync job and service logs for the review window.
